meta.name: Obsess
meta.description:
After returning home, Talal is pulled into a dark psychological journey where the lines between guilt, desire and his own disturbing impulses begin to blur. As buried feelings connected to a past love resurface, the darkness inside him grows stronger. Talal is forced to confront a terrifying question: can he free himself from his past, or will it consume him completely?

Complete series. On your server: S1 4/4

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Burdened by his responsibilities and the ghosts of his past, “Talal” returns to “Kuwait” for the first time in years, where lingering feelings continue to haunt him.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: When Talal is plagued by disturbing dreams, he is forced to delve into his father's deteriorating mental state and unearth an old relationship he thought had been buried long ago.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: When "Talal" receives a diary from "Hessa's" sister, he begins to uncover the horrifying details that contributed to the tragic fate of his former lover.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: At "Mona's" hospital bedside, "Talal" confronts more secrets, but he realizes that he must break the curse and come to terms with his past to find peace.
